# Metre

> Metre is an iOS app (iPhone and iPad, iOS 17 or later) by gokchetech: an AR tape measure that uses the camera to measure length, height, area, volume, angles and whole rooms, with 50 animated how-to demos. It works without LiDAR; LiDAR devices find surfaces faster and add 3D room scan. Processing is on-device: no account, no analytics, no ads, no tracking.

Key facts:
- Name: Metre (App Store title "Metre: Tape Measure & AR Ruler"). Publisher: gokchetech. Category: Utilities.
- Localized App Store names: English: "Metre: Tape Measure & AR Ruler"; Türkçe: "Metre: Ölçüm & Mezura"; Deutsch: "Metre: Maßband & Lineal"; Français: "Metre: Règle & Niveau à bulle"; Español: "Metre: Cinta Métrica y Regla"; Português (Brasil): "Metre: Trena e Régua Digital"; 日本語: "Metre: AR定規・巻尺・水平器".
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad, iOS 17.0 or later. 36 languages. Metric and imperial units.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6826332249
- Price: free to download, but Metre needs Metre Pro to measure (there is no free tier; the monthly plan starts with a 3-day free trial).
- Metre Pro (in-app purchase): weekly or monthly auto-renewing subscription (the monthly plan starts with a 3-day free trial), or a one-time lifetime purchase. Includes every tool: length, height (including automatic person height), bubble level and plumb, on-screen ruler, all 50 how-to demos, saving measurements, Smart scan, area, box and volume, angle, circle, door check, whole-home survey, 3D room scan, Will it fit?, windows and curtains, paint and flooring, site calculator, kitchen planner, body measurements, child height tracker, shoe size, ring sizer, measure a photo, and exports (PDF and CSV; DXF and USDZ only from LiDAR 3D room scans).
- Accuracy: measurements are estimates, and no camera-only phone is millimetre-exact. Accuracy depends on light, surface, distance and a steady hand; LiDAR devices find surfaces faster and usually more reliably. Every result shows a margin of error (± cm or in) and a quality label (Accurate, Good, Approx.); a precision ring shows confidence, and Settings has an A4 or bank-card accuracy check. Verify critical dimensions with a physical tape.
- Privacy: camera frames, photos and scans are processed on the device with Apple's ARKit, Vision and RoomPlan and never uploaded. No account, no tracking, no third-party SDKs. Measurements are stored locally on the device. App Store privacy label: Data Not Collected.

## Features
- AR tape measure: length and height; automatic person height via body detection
- Smart scan: the camera outlines an object (table, window, door, garment, shoe) and reads width × height as an estimate with a margin of error; works without LiDAR
- Area, box and volume, angle, circle (diameter, circumference, area), door check
- Whole-home survey room by room: m², m³, net vs total area, bird's-eye floor plan, listing PDF export (the Home survey has no DXF export)
- 3D room scan with floor plan on LiDAR iPhones and iPads (Apple RoomPlan); saved scans export as USDZ (3D model), DXF (CAD) and PDF
- Will it fit?: true-size virtual box for furniture
- Calculators: windows and curtains; paint, flooring, wallpaper; concrete (m³ and bags), tiles with adhesive and grout, stairs, slope; kitchen planner (cabinets, filler, worktop, elevation)
- Body measurements and a client measurement book for tailors, plus an approximate size estimate from a photo
- Child height tracker, shoe size (EU/UK/US), ring sizer (US/UK/EU/JP)
- On-screen ruler calibrated with a bank card, bubble level and plumb, measure on a photo with a bank card or A4 reference
- 50 animated how-to demos; widgets; Siri Shortcuts

## How-to guides (English, metric and US units)
- [All how-to guides](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/): index
- [How to measure a door opening with an iPhone](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/measure-a-door-opening-with-iphone.html): Clear width and height of a doorway, and what to leave spare.
- [Will my sofa fit through the door? How to check before you buy](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/will-my-sofa-fit-through-the-door.html): The sizes to compare, both orientations and a true-size AR box.
- [How to measure a room's square footage (m²) with your phone](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/measure-room-square-footage-iphone.html): Length times width, odd shapes and a m² to sq ft table.
- [How to make a floor plan of your home with an iPhone](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/make-a-floor-plan-of-your-home-with-iphone.html): Tap the corners room by room and get one plan with the total area.
- [How to find your ring size at home with a phone or paper](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/find-your-ring-size-at-home.html): Inside diameter to US, UK and EU sizes, with a chart.
- [How to measure a person's height with a phone camera](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/measure-a-persons-height-with-a-phone.html): Head to toe in one frame, plus a wall-and-book method and a cm to ft table.
- [How accurate are phone measuring apps? What to expect and how to test](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/phone-measuring-app-accuracy.html): What affects the error, which jobs are fine, and a 20-second test.
- [How to measure a window for curtains and blinds](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/measure-a-window-for-curtains.html): Rod length, curtain width and drop, in cm and inches.
- [How much paint do I need for a room?](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/how-much-paint-for-a-room.html): Wall area, doors and windows, coats and coverage, in litres and gallons.
- [How much concrete do I need for a slab?](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/concrete-slab-volume-calculator.html): Area times thickness in m³ and cubic yards, with a waste allowance.
- [How to take body measurements for clothes](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/measure-your-body-for-clothes.html): Where the tape goes for each measurement, in a tailor's order.
- [How to measure your foot and find your shoe size at home](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/measure-your-feet-and-find-your-shoe-size.html): Heel against the wall, longest toe to the line, then convert.
- [Which iPhones and iPads have LiDAR, and do you need it to measure?](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/does-my-iphone-have-lidar.html): Which devices have it, and what changes without it.
- [How to use your iPhone as a spirit level](https://faruksengul.github.io/github.io/metre/guides/use-your-iphone-as-a-spirit-level.html): Lay it flat or hold the edge, then zero it on a known flat surface.
